purpose: Capture-complete replication of e018 after fixing volatile DDS loss of accepted-goal boundary events
independence_limit: This repeats e018's seed and scenario configuration to validate repaired capture. Treat e018 as excluded instrumentation failure and count at most e019 as one independent scenario instance; never count both.
inclusion_rule: Include in development evaluation only if simulator/capture gates pass, one accepted-goal event and matching terminal result are captured, recovery history is complete, one or two unique Wait attempts are recorded, and evaluator truth confirms hold and release.
mismatch_rule: Retain any valid artifact as calibration and do not alter timings, tune the same run, or relabel its family after observing the result.
evidence_boundary: The mobility intervention and its timing are evaluator-only. Robot-visible explanations may state the captured controller-progress/BT mechanism, but must not claim the physical reason for lack of progress.
